snippet.title: PlayStation - Bardysh - Kromeford no Juunin (1999)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Bardysh: Kromeford no Juunin is a Role-Playing game, developed by Infinity and published by Imadio, which was released in Japan in 1999.
